name: akyba-dev
description: Development tooling only (commit checks, Markdown/JSON formatting). Akyba itself is Rust: see Cargo.toml.

scripts.health: pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run deps
scripts.dev: cargo build -p akyba && sh scripts/sign-local.sh target/debug/akyba && target/debug/akyba
scripts.gallery: cargo build -p akyba && sh scripts/sign-local.sh target/debug/akyba && AKYBA_GALLERY=1 target/debug/akyba
